answer_1.quote: We present a novel benchmarking task for the LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm: rating long debate speeches arguing for or against a controversial topic.
datasets: data collected by Slonim et al. (2021)

answer_2.quote: We employ weighted Kappa agreement... We use the Kendall's Tau-C correlation metric as it can handle agreement between variables with different possible values...

answer_3.quote: We run a series of experiments to assess the performance of judges (Q1) and assess their behavior (Q2). These experiments involve running multiple LLMs as judges on the speech dataset and measuring their agreement with humans.
criteria: This speech is a good opening speech to support the topic

answer_4.quote: Each speech in the dataset was carefully rated by multiple crowd annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Given the speech and the topic of the debate, the annotators were asked to score the following statement on a Likert scale between 1 and 5: "This speech is a good opening speech to support the topic"
criteria: This speech is a good opening speech to support the topic
Most arguments in this speech support the topic
